- Left align (`<`) adds fill characters after the value (s + fill*)
- Right align (`>`) adds fill characters before the value (fill* + s)
- Center align (`^`) adds fill characters on both sides (fill* + s + fill*)

The requirement says "Left- and center-aligned search operations must consume input up to the next space character." This means when doing a search (not exact match), left-aligned and center-aligned patterns should stop consuming at whitespace.
